title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Your AI can say the test passed. Code Factory asks whether the test could ever have failed. Solo developers start with one local proof; teams bind the real diff, sealed intent, independent checks, and receipts instead of trusting an agent's narrative. Core version 0.46.0 adds a read-only Agent Proof Bridge for Eve, Junie, Grok Build, and generic clients; FactoryLine IDE adapters are version 0.9.0. The bridge verifies a typed acyclic workflow DAG, scoped source preconditions, real before/after artifact hashes, provider-declared checkpoint continuity, and the current Oracle Contract without contacting or operating an external agent. It also produces local, review-required Proof Worklog drafts from sealed evidence only; it never posts to a ticketing, chat, or source-control service. The deterministic AppForge App Review evidence gate remains visible in FactoryLine: 30 policy and release-risk checks bind the exact app build to the required local evidence and preserve named human control. Inspect a hash-verified iOS review story, user design input, Graph Ops mission-control storyboard, quality evidence, and submission dossier before entering the queue. The workflow is designed to reduce avoidable App Review rework and waiting time; it does not guarantee approval or claim a measured rejection-rate reduction.

Supplied local observations are not provider certification, payment settlement, production proof, security or compliance certification, or release authority.
